name: Krisha Login Branding
author: Deepak Jagtap

sections.description:
Krisha Login Branding lets you easily customize the WordPress login page without writing code.
Perfect for developers, agencies, and website owners who want to match the login page to their brand.

Features:
– Upload and set a custom login logo.
– Adjust logo width and height.
– Change login page background color.
– Customize login form background color.
– Add your own custom CSS.
– Live preview while editing settings.
– Option to hide “Lost your password?” link.
– Option to hide “← Back to site” link.
– “Reset to Default” button to restore original WordPress login design.

This plugin is lightweight, simple, and designed to give you full branding control over your login page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/krisha-login-branding directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Login Branding to configure your login page.
  4. Customize your logo, colors, background, and CSS.
    Use the live preview to see changes instantly.
  5. Click Save Changes to apply them.
    Use Reset to Default anytime to restore the original login page.
sections.faq:
Can I preview my changes before saving?

Yes! The plugin includes a live preview iframe so you can see your custom login design instantly before saving.

Will this affect my WordPress admin dashboard?

No. It only customizes the login page (wp-login.php).

Can I add my own CSS?

Yes. There’s a custom CSS box in the settings where you can paste your own styles.

How do I reset back to WordPress defaults?

Click the Reset to Default button in the settings page.
